Subject: Thanks for today — quick recap & next step (demo)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the candid discussion about your inference cost pressures and the need for predictable latency. Quick recap from our side: 

- Key pain: spiky inference traffic during peak support hours and inconsistent 95th percentile latency across regions.
- What mattered: predictable unit economics, ability to pin model versions for compliance, and a private deployment option.
- Next step we agreed: 30–45 minute technical demo + architecture deep dive with your infra lead (Tom) to cover network/topology, KMS integration, and rollback/fallback policy.

I proposed a demo window during the call but I realize calendars are tight. Would any of these work for you (all 30 minutes + time for Qs):

- Tue 22 Jun, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Tue 22 Jun, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Wed 23 Jun, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

If you pick one I’ll send an invite and include Marissa (solutions engineer) and the architecture doc. I’ll also attach a short demo agenda.

Cheers,
Dylan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Dylan: (415) 555-0192 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com
